summary: Bank of Marin Bancorp filed a routine Form 8-K on October 2, 2026, announcing only that it will webcast third-quarter 2026 earnings on Monday, October 26, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. PT / 11:30 a.m. ET, with results released before the call. President and CEO Tim Myers and EVP/CFO Dave Bonaccorso will discuss results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms are stated. This is an ordinary investor-communications notice, not a special situation; the only thing to watch is Q3 results and any credit commentary.
